create or replace view public.v_admin_health_snapshot as  WITH cfg AS (
         SELECT get_setting_int('stale_session_timeout_minutes'::text, 120) AS stale_timeout_minutes,
            get_setting_int('scan_history_warning_mb'::text, 350) AS scan_history_warning_mb,
            operational_day_start(now()) AS operational_day_start
        ), storage AS (
         SELECT scan_history_storage_summary() AS summary
        ), counts AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM custodial_open_work() custodial_open_work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
                  WHERE custodial_open_work.status = 'active'::text) AS active_sessions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM custodial_open_work() custodial_open_work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
                  WHERE custodial_open_work.status = 'pending_submit'::text) AS pending_submit_sessions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM sessions
                  WHERE sessions.status = 'closed'::text AND COALESCE(sessions.ended_at, sessions.started_at, sessions.created_at) >= (( SELECT cfg.operational_day_start
                           FROM cfg))) AS closed_sessions_today,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_open_maintenance_tickets) AS open_ticket_count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_location_dashboard_status
                  WHERE v_location_dashboard_status.status_code = 'overdue'::text) AS overdue_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_location_dashboard_status
                  WHERE v_location_dashboard_status.status_code = 'due_soon'::text) AS due_soon_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM v_location_dashboard_status
                  WHERE v_location_dashboard_status.status_code = 'in_progress'::text) AS in_progress_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM locations
                  WHERE locations.active = true) AS active_locations,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM devices
                  WHERE devices.active = true) AS active_devices,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM devices
                  WHERE devices.active = true AND devices.last_seen_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS devices_seen_last_24h,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM devices
                  WHERE devices.active = true AND (devices.last_seen_at IS NULL OR devices.last_seen_at < (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))) AS devices_missing_recent_heartbeat,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM custodial_open_work() custodial_open_work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
                  WHERE COALESCE(custodial_open_work.ended_at, custodial_open_work.started_at) <= (now() - make_interval(mins => ( SELECT cfg.stale_timeout_minutes
                           FROM cfg)))) AS stale_open_sessions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM system_logs
                  WHERE (system_logs.level = ANY (ARRAY['WARN'::text, 'ERROR'::text])) AND system_logs.created_at >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval)) AS warn_error_logs_last_24h
        )
 SELECT now() AS snapshot_at,
    ( SELECT cfg.operational_day_start
           FROM cfg) AS operational_day_start,
    ( SELECT cfg.stale_timeout_minutes
           FROM cfg) AS stale_timeout_minutes,
    ( SELECT cfg.scan_history_warning_mb
           FROM cfg) AS scan_history_warning_mb,
    counts.active_sessions,
    counts.pending_submit_sessions,
    counts.closed_sessions_today,
    counts.open_ticket_count,
    counts.overdue_locations,
    counts.due_soon_locations,
    counts.in_progress_locations,
    counts.active_locations,
    counts.active_devices,
    counts.devices_seen_last_24h,
    counts.devices_missing_recent_heartbeat,
    counts.stale_open_sessions,
    counts.warn_error_logs_last_24h,
    storage.summary AS storage_summary
   FROM counts
     CROSS JOIN storage; alter view public.v_admin_health_snapshot reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_admin_health_snapshot owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_exception_queue as  SELECT 'open_ticket'::text AS exception_type,
    ticket.ticket_id::text AS entity_id,
    ticket.location_code,
    ticket.location_name,
    ticket.date_submitted AS event_at,
    ticket.date_submitted_display AS event_at_display,
    ticket.maintenance_issue AS summary,
    ticket.reported_by AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('fixture_type', ticket.fixture_type, 'fixture_identifier', ticket.fixture_identifier, 'out_of_order', ticket.out_of_order, 'status', ticket.status) AS details
   FROM v_open_maintenance_tickets ticket
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'overdue_location'::text AS exception_type,
    location.location_id::text AS entity_id,
    location.location_code,
    location.location_name,
    location.latest_completed_at AS event_at,
    location.latest_completed_at_display AS event_at_display,
    'Location overdue for cleaning'::text AS summary,
    location.latest_employee_name AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('form_type', location.form_type, 'status_code', location.status_code, 'status_color', location.status_color, 'open_ticket_count', location.open_ticket_count) AS details
   FROM v_location_dashboard_status location
  WHERE location.status_code = 'overdue'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'stale_device'::text AS exception_type,
    device.id::text AS entity_id,
    NULL::text AS location_code,
    device.device_name AS location_name,
    GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) AS event_at,
        CASE
            WHEN GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) IS NULL THEN 'Never seen'::text
            ELSE to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at)), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text
        END AS event_at_display,
    'Device missing recent heartbeat'::text AS summary,
    device.device_id AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('device_id', device.device_id, 'active', device.active, 'last_seen_at', device.last_seen_at, 'last_server_ack_at', sync.last_server_ack_at, 'sync_updated_at', sync.updated_at) AS details
   FROM devices device
     LEFT JOIN device_sync_status sync ON sync.device_id = device.id
  WHERE device.active = true AND device.assigned_employee_id IS NOT NULL AND (GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) IS NULL OR GREATEST(device.last_seen_at, sync.last_server_ack_at, sync.updated_at) < (now() - '24:00:00'::interval))
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'stale_open_session'::text AS exception_type,
    work.session_uuid AS entity_id,
    work.location_code,
    work.location_name,
    COALESCE(work.ended_at, work.started_at) AS event_at,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, COALESCE(work.ended_at, work.started_at)), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS event_at_display,
    'Open session exceeded stale timeout'::text AS summary,
    work.employee_name AS actor,
    jsonb_build_object('status', work.status, 'device_id', work.device_identifier, 'started_at', work.started_at, 'ended_at', work.ended_at) AS details
   FROM custodial_open_work() work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
  WHERE COALESCE(work.ended_at, work.started_at) <= (now() - make_interval(mins => get_setting_int('stale_session_timeout_minutes'::text, 120))); alter view public.v_exception_queue reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_exception_queue owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_location_dashboard_status as  WITH op_day AS (
         SELECT operational_day_start(now()) AS day_start,
            sch_service_date(now()) AS service_date
        ), authority AS (
         SELECT state.service_date,
            state.governed,
            state.authority_source,
            state.projection_status,
            state.version_id,
            state.publication_id,
            state.projection_id,
            state.projection_authority_revision,
            state.staffing_authority_revision,
            state.week_start
           FROM op_day day
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL static_weekly_v6_schedule_authority_state(day.service_date) state(service_date, governed, authority_source, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id, projection_authority_revision, staffing_authority_revision, week_start)
        ), scheduled_baseline AS (
         SELECT assignment.location_id,
            min(((day.service_date + assignment.coverage_start) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'::text)) AS baseline_at
           FROM op_day day
             JOIN LATERAL custodial_operational_location_assignments(day.service_date) assignment(service_date, authority_source, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id, occurrence_id, location_group_id, group_code, group_name, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, assignment_status, coverage_start, coverage_end, location_id, location_code, location_name, form_type) ON true
          GROUP BY assignment.location_id
        ), latest_scan AS (
         SELECT scan_events.location_id,
            max(COALESCE(scan_events.scanned_at, scan_events.created_at)) AS last_scan_at
           FROM scan_events
          GROUP BY scan_events.location_id
        ), open_session AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (work.location_id) work.location_id,
            work.location_code,
            work.session_id,
            work.session_uuid,
            work.status AS session_status,
            work.started_at,
            work.ended_at,
            work.duration_minutes,
            work.duration_display,
            work.employee_name,
            work.device_identifier
           FROM custodial_open_work() work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
          WHERE work.source_kind <> 'session'::text OR work.started_at >= operational_day_start(now())
          ORDER BY work.location_id, work.started_at DESC, work.created_at DESC, work.open_work_id DESC
        ), latest_completed AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (session.location_id) session.location_id,
            session.id AS session_id,
            session.session_uuid,
            session.started_at,
            session.ended_at,
            session.duration_minutes,
            session.duration_display,
            employee.display_name AS employee_name,
            completion.submitted_at,
            completion.response_json,
            COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) AS effective_completed_at
           FROM sessions session
             JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = session.employee_id
             LEFT JOIN completion_responses completion ON completion.session_id = session.id
             CROSS JOIN op_day day
          WHERE session.status = 'closed'::text AND (completion.response_json ->> 'work_result'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'checked_no_cleaning_needed'::text AND COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) >= day.day_start
          ORDER BY session.location_id, (COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at)) DESC, session.started_at DESC
        ), open_tickets AS (
         SELECT maintenance_tickets.location_id,
            count(*) AS open_ticket_count
           FROM maintenance_tickets
          WHERE maintenance_tickets.status = 'open'::text
          GROUP BY maintenance_tickets.location_id
        ), truth AS (
         SELECT location.id AS location_id,
            COALESCE(open_session.location_code, location.location_code) AS location_code,
            place_operational_location_name(location.id, statement_timestamp()) AS location_name,
            location.location_type,
            location.form_type,
            day.day_start,
            latest_scan.last_scan_at,
            open_session.session_id AS open_session_id,
            open_session.session_uuid AS open_session_uuid,
            open_session.session_status AS open_session_status,
            open_session.started_at AS open_session_started_at,
            open_session.ended_at AS open_session_ended_at,
            open_session.employee_name AS open_session_employee_name,
            open_session.device_identifier AS open_session_device_identifier,
            latest_completed.session_id AS latest_completed_session_id,
            latest_completed.session_uuid AS latest_completed_session_uuid,
            latest_completed.started_at AS latest_started_at,
            latest_completed.ended_at AS latest_ended_at,
            latest_completed.submitted_at AS latest_submitted_at,
            latest_completed.effective_completed_at AS latest_completed_at,
            latest_completed.employee_name AS latest_employee_name,
            latest_completed.duration_minutes,
            latest_completed.duration_display,
            latest_completed.response_json,
            COALESCE(open_tickets.open_ticket_count, 0::bigint) AS open_ticket_count,
            scheduled_baseline.baseline_at,
            mz_latest_verified_check(location.id, day.day_start, now()) AS verified_check_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN latest_completed.effective_completed_at IS NULL THEN NULL::timestamp with time zone
                    ELSE GREATEST(latest_completed.effective_completed_at, mz_latest_verified_check(location.id, day.day_start, now()))
                END AS due_baseline_at,
            authority.authority_source AS schedule_authority_source,
            authority.projection_status AS schedule_projection_status
           FROM locations location
             CROSS JOIN op_day day
             CROSS JOIN authority
             LEFT JOIN scheduled_baseline ON scheduled_baseline.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN latest_scan ON latest_scan.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN open_session ON open_session.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN latest_completed ON latest_completed.location_id = location.id
             LEFT JOIN open_tickets ON open_tickets.location_id = location.id
          WHERE location.active = true
        )
 SELECT location_id,
    location_code,
    location_name,
    location_type,
    form_type,
    day_start AS operational_day_start,
    last_scan_at,
    open_session_id,
    open_session_uuid,
    open_session_status,
    open_session_started_at,
    open_session_ended_at,
    latest_completed_session_id,
    latest_completed_session_uuid,
    latest_started_at,
    latest_ended_at,
    latest_submitted_at,
    latest_completed_at,
    latest_employee_name,
    duration_minutes,
    duration_display,
    COALESCE(response_json -> 'services_performed'::text, response_json -> 'servicesPerformed'::text, response_json -> 'services'::text, response_json -> 'completed_services'::text, response_json -> 'completedServices'::text, '[]'::jsonb) AS services_performed,
    COALESCE(response_json ->> 'notes'::text, response_json ->> 'cleaning_notes'::text, response_json ->> 'cleaningNotes'::text, response_json ->> 'maintenance_notes'::text, response_json ->> 'maintenanceNotes'::text, response_json ->> 'other_service_performed'::text, response_json ->> 'otherServicePerformed'::text, response_json ->> 'note'::text) AS notes,
    open_ticket_count,
        CASE
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL AND (open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text])) THEN 'in_progress'::text
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL THEN 'not_cleaned'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_overdue_minutes'::text, 90)
            END)) THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_due_soon_minutes'::text, 75)
            END)) THEN 'due_soon'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_overdue_minutes'::text, 210)
            END)) THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_due_soon_minutes'::text, 195)
            END)) THEN 'due_soon'::text
            WHEN open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text]) THEN 'in_progress'::text
            ELSE 'okay'::text
        END AS status_code,
        CASE
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL AND (open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text])) THEN 'blue'::text
            WHEN due_baseline_at IS NULL THEN 'black'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_overdue_minutes'::text, 90)
            END)) OR form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 180
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_overdue_minutes'::text, 210)
            END)) THEN 'red'::text
            WHEN form_type = 'restroom'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('restroom_due_soon_minutes'::text, 75)
            END)) OR form_type = 'exhibit'::text AND now() >= (due_baseline_at + make_interval(mins =>
            CASE
                WHEN mz_is_approved_admin_location(location_id, now()) THEN 165
                ELSE get_setting_int('exhibit_due_soon_minutes'::text, 195)
            END)) THEN 'yellow'::text
            WHEN open_session_status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text]) THEN 'blue'::text
            ELSE 'green'::text
        END AS status_color,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, day_start), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS operational_day_start_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, last_scan_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS last_scan_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, open_session_started_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS open_session_started_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, open_session_ended_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS open_session_ended_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_started_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_started_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_ended_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_ended_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_submitted_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_submitted_at_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest_completed_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS latest_completed_at_display,
    open_session_employee_name,
    open_session_device_identifier,
    schedule_authority_source,
    schedule_projection_status,
    GREATEST(latest_completed_at, verified_check_at) AS latest_checked_at
   FROM truth; alter view public.v_location_dashboard_status reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_location_dashboard_status owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_location_status as  WITH work_candidates AS (
         SELECT work.location_id,
            work.location_code,
            work.session_id,
            work.session_uuid,
            work.status AS session_status,
            work.started_at,
            work.ended_at,
            work.duration_minutes,
            work.duration_display,
            work.employee_name,
            work.device_identifier AS device_id,
            work.created_at,
            0 AS source_priority
           FROM custodial_open_work() work(open_work_id, source_kind, session_id, context_id, session_uuid, client_session_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, employee_id, employee_name, device_id, device_identifier, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_minutes, duration_display, created_at)
          WHERE work.source_kind <> 'session'::text OR work.started_at >= operational_day_start(now())
        UNION ALL
         SELECT session.location_id,
            NULL::text AS text,
            session.id,
            session.session_uuid,
            session.status,
            session.started_at,
            session.ended_at,
            session.duration_minutes,
            session.duration_display,
            employee.display_name,
            device.device_id,
            session.created_at,
            1 AS source_priority
           FROM sessions session
             LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = session.employee_id
             LEFT JOIN devices device ON device.id = session.device_id
          WHERE session.status <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::text, 'pending_submit'::text])
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT location.id AS location_id,
            COALESCE(work.location_code, location.location_code) AS location_code,
            location.location_name,
            location.location_type,
            location.active AS location_active,
            work.session_id,
            work.session_uuid,
            work.session_status,
            work.started_at,
            work.ended_at,
            work.duration_minutes,
            work.duration_display,
            work.employee_name,
            work.device_id,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY location.id ORDER BY work.source_priority, work.started_at DESC NULLS LAST, work.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, work.session_id DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
           FROM locations location
             LEFT JOIN work_candidates work ON work.location_id = location.id
        )
 SELECT location_id,
    location_code,
    location_name,
    location_type,
    location_active,
    session_id,
    session_uuid,
    session_status,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    duration_minutes,
    duration_display,
    employee_name,
    device_id
   FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1; alter view public.v_location_status reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_location_status owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_memphis_area_schedule as  WITH authority_dates AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT occurrence.service_date
           FROM weekly_schedule_occurrences occurrence
        UNION
         SELECT DISTINCT assignment.service_date
           FROM daily_schedule_assignments assignment
        UNION
         SELECT custodial_dated_service_dates.service_date
           FROM custodial_dated_service_dates() custodial_dated_service_dates(service_date)
        )
 SELECT segment.service_date,
    segment.location_group_id,
    segment.group_code,
    segment.group_name,
    segment.segment_number,
    segment.assigned_employee_id,
    segment.assigned_employee_name,
    employee.employee_code,
    "left"(segment.coverage_start, 5) AS coverage_start,
    "left"(segment.coverage_end, 5) AS coverage_end,
    segment.status,
    segment.owner_type,
    segment.load_points::numeric(10,2) AS load_points,
    segment.source_type,
    segment.notes
   FROM authority_dates authority_date
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(authority_date.service_date) segment(service_date, location_group_id, group_code, group_name, included_locations, included_location_ids, segment_id, segment_number, owner_type, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, coverage_start, coverage_end, status, load_points, coverage_purpose, notes, source_type, service_mode, governed, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id)
     LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = segment.assigned_employee_id; alter view public.v_memphis_area_schedule reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_memphis_area_schedule owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_open_maintenance_tickets as  SELECT mt.id AS ticket_id,
    COALESCE(mt.location_code_snapshot, l.location_code) AS location_code,
    COALESCE(mt.location_name_snapshot, l.location_name) AS location_name,
    mt.reported_at AS date_submitted,
    mt.issue_summary AS maintenance_issue,
    COALESCE(mt.reporter_name_snapshot, e.display_name) AS reported_by,
    mt.fixture_type,
    mt.fixture_identifier,
    mt.out_of_order,
    mt.status,
    mt.issue_payload,
    mt.close_notes,
    mt.created_at,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, mt.reported_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY'::text) AS date_submitted_date_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, mt.reported_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS date_submitted_display,
    to_char(timezone('America/Chicago'::text, mt.created_at), 'MM/DD/YYYY HH12:MI AM'::text) || ' Central'::text AS created_at_display,
    mt.issue_source
   FROM maintenance_tickets mt
     LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id = mt.location_id
     LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = mt.reported_by_employee_id
  WHERE mt.status = 'open'::text; alter view public.v_open_maintenance_tickets reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_open_maintenance_tickets owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_restroom_check_timers as  WITH restroom_locations AS (
         SELECT group_row.id AS location_group_id,
            group_row.group_code,
            group_row.group_name,
            location.id AS location_id,
            location.location_code,
            location.location_name
           FROM location_groups group_row
             JOIN location_group_memberships membership ON membership.location_group_id = group_row.id AND membership.active = true
             JOIN locations location ON location.id = membership.location_id AND location.active = true
          WHERE group_row.active = true AND lower(COALESCE(location.form_type, location.location_type, ''::text)) = 'restroom'::text AND sch_is_public_restroom_group(group_row.id) AND NOT (location.location_name ~~* '%East Admin%'::text OR location.location_name ~~* '%West Admin%'::text OR location.location_name ~~* '%Elephant Trunk%'::text)
        ), activity AS (
         SELECT session.location_id,
            COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) AS activity_at,
            COALESCE(submitter.display_name, employee.display_name) AS actor_name,
            COALESCE(completion_device.device_id, device.device_id) AS device_identifier
           FROM sessions session
             LEFT JOIN completion_responses completion ON completion.session_id = session.id
             LEFT JOIN employees submitter ON submitter.id = completion.submitted_by_employee_id
             LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = session.employee_id
             LEFT JOIN devices completion_device ON completion_device.id = completion.device_id
             LEFT JOIN devices device ON device.id = session.device_id
          WHERE COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) >= operational_day_start(now()) AND session.status = 'closed'::text AND ((completion.response_json ->> 'work_result'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'checked_no_cleaning_needed'::text OR session.ended_at = mz_latest_verified_check(session.location_id, operational_day_start(now()), now()))
        ), latest_completion AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (restroom_1.location_id) restroom_1.location_id,
            activity.activity_at AS last_completed_at,
            activity.actor_name AS last_completed_by,
            activity.device_identifier AS last_completed_device
           FROM restroom_locations restroom_1
             LEFT JOIN activity ON activity.location_id = restroom_1.location_id
          ORDER BY restroom_1.location_id, activity.activity_at DESC NULLS LAST
        ), current_owner AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (assignment.location_group_id) assignment.location_group_id,
            assignment.assigned_employee_id,
            employee.display_name AS assigned_owner,
            assignment.coverage_start::time without time zone AS coverage_start,
            assignment.coverage_end::time without time zone AS coverage_end,
            assignment.coverage_purpose,
            assignment.status
           FROM static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(sch_service_date(now())) assignment(service_date, location_group_id, group_code, group_name, included_locations, included_location_ids, segment_id, segment_number, owner_type, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, coverage_start, coverage_end, status, load_points, coverage_purpose, notes, source_type, service_mode, governed, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id)
             LEFT JOIN employees employee ON employee.id = assignment.assigned_employee_id
          WHERE assignment.service_date = sch_service_date(now()) AND timezone('America/Chicago'::text, now())::time without time zone >= assignment.coverage_start::time without time zone AND timezone('America/Chicago'::text, now())::time without time zone < assignment.coverage_end::time without time zone
          ORDER BY assignment.location_group_id, (
                CASE
                    WHEN assignment.coverage_purpose = ANY (ARRAY['restroom_check'::text, 'restroom_upkeep'::text, 'area_owner'::text]) THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END), assignment.coverage_start DESC
        )
 SELECT sch_service_date(now()) AS service_date,
    restroom.location_group_id,
    restroom.group_code,
    restroom.group_name AS schedule_package_name,
    restroom.location_id,
    restroom.location_code,
    restroom.location_name AS scanned_restroom_name,
    latest.last_completed_at,
    timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest.last_completed_at) AS last_completed_at_central,
    latest.last_completed_by,
    latest.last_completed_device,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS next_check_due_at,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS next_check_due_at_central,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NULL OR latest.last_completed_at IS NULL THEN 'not_cleaned_yet'::text
            WHEN (latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval) <= now() THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN (latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval) <= (now() + '00:15:00'::interval) THEN 'due_soon'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS timer_status,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval - now()) / 60.0)::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS minutes_until_due,
    owner.assigned_employee_id,
    owner.assigned_owner,
    to_char(owner.coverage_start::interval, 'HH24:MI'::text) AS owner_coverage_start,
    to_char(owner.coverage_end::interval, 'HH24:MI'::text) AS owner_coverage_end,
    owner.coverage_purpose,
    owner.status AS owner_status,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'scan_completion'::text
            ELSE 'no_scan_today'::text
        END AS timer_source
   FROM restroom_locations restroom
     LEFT JOIN v_location_dashboard_status dashboard ON dashboard.location_id = restroom.location_id
     LEFT JOIN latest_completion latest ON latest.location_id = restroom.location_id
     LEFT JOIN current_owner owner ON owner.location_group_id = restroom.location_group_id; alter view public.v_restroom_check_timers reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_restroom_check_timers owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_restroom_package_status as  SELECT service_date,
    location_group_id,
    group_code,
    schedule_package_name,
    count(*)::integer AS restroom_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status <> 'not_cleaned_yet'::text)::integer AS cleaned_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'not_cleaned_yet'::text)::integer AS not_cleaned_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'due_soon'::text)::integer AS due_soon_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'overdue'::text)::integer AS overdue_count,
    min(next_check_due_at) FILTER (WHERE next_check_due_at IS NOT NULL) AS next_package_due_at,
    min(next_check_due_at_central) FILTER (WHERE next_check_due_at_central IS NOT NULL) AS next_package_due_at_central,
    assigned_employee_id,
    assigned_owner,
    owner_coverage_start,
    owner_coverage_end,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'overdue'::text) > 0 THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'due_soon'::text) > 0 THEN 'due_soon'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'not_cleaned_yet'::text) = count(*) THEN 'not_cleaned_yet'::text
            WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE timer_status = 'not_cleaned_yet'::text) > 0 THEN 'partially_cleaned'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS package_status
   FROM v_restroom_check_timers
  GROUP BY service_date, location_group_id, group_code, schedule_package_name, assigned_employee_id, assigned_owner, owner_coverage_start, owner_coverage_end; alter view public.v_restroom_package_status reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_restroom_package_status owner to supabase_admin;

create or replace view public.v_weekly_schedule_effective_ranges as  WITH winners AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.effective_start) v.version_id,
            v.version_number,
            p.effective_start,
            v.publication_kind,
            v.content_digest
           FROM weekly_schedule_publications p
             JOIN weekly_schedule_versions v ON v.version_id = p.version_id
          WHERE v.lifecycle_state = 'published'::text
          ORDER BY p.effective_start, p.authority_revision DESC
        )
 SELECT version_id,
    version_number,
    effective_start,
    lead(effective_start) OVER (ORDER BY effective_start) AS effective_end,
    publication_kind,
    content_digest
   FROM winners; alter view public.v_weekly_schedule_effective_ranges reset (check_option,security_barrier,security_invoker); alter view public.v_weekly_schedule_effective_ranges owner to supabase_admin;
